entries.wording: A label has been created and we are waiting to receive your package at our warehouse for delivery.
entries.note: The label. Also "We have received information about your delivery. If you are experiencing a delay, please contact the retailer".

entries.wording: Your order has been confirmed and we will process your package once it arrives at a Jitsu warehouse.
entries.note: A delivery plan. Before the parcel moves it is the label; after, such as once the parcel is back at Jitsu for another attempt, it moves nothing.
Jitsu cannot deliver the order and sends the recipient to the merchant.
A partner carrier's scan on the way to Jitsu, worded "Approximate location." and its town, or a notice that it runs late.

entries.wording: Your package has been received at a Jitsu facility and will be delivered soon.
Your package has been received at a Jitsu facility.
entries.note: Dropped within a minute of the receipt scan, which it repeats, as on the tracker.

entries.wording: Your package has been received at a Jitsu facility.
Your package has been received at a Jitsu facility.

entries.note: A facility scan the service words itself.

entries.wording: We have encountered an issue with your package and will not be able to complete your delivery. Please contact the merchant for further assistance.
entries.note: Received damaged; Jitsu will not deliver it.

entries.wording: We have encountered an issue with your package and will not be able to complete your delivery. Please contact the merchant for further assistance.

entries.note: No news, with a day after which the recipient should contact the merchant.

entries.wording: We are still waiting to receive your package at our warehouse for delivery.
entries.note: A notice: Jitsu is still waiting for the parcel. It moves nothing.

entries.wording: We are still waiting for your package. We will process your package as soon as it arrives.
entries.note: A notice. It moves nothing.

entries.wording: We are still waiting to receive your package at our warehouse. Delivery date details are updated.
entries.note: A notice. It moves nothing.

entries.wording: Your package may be delayed. We are working to process your package for delivery.
entries.note: A notice. It moves nothing.
A new delivery date, worded for a parcel at the warehouse or one still awaited. It moves nothing.
The parcel is on the day's round, which has not left yet: "Your package has been scheduled to be delivered by" the end of the window.
The driver has taken the parcel from Jitsu's facility for the round: "Your package is on its way to be delivered by" the end of the window.
A round that left without the parcel. It moves nothing once the facility has the parcel; before that, the parcel is missing.
The round runs late and may deliver the next day. It moves nothing; the tracker moves the window to the next service day.

entries.wording: Your package may be delayed. We are working to process your package for delivery.
entries.note: A notice. It moves nothing.
The delivery runs late, with the reason the driver gave. It moves nothing.
The recipient's stop is next.

entries.wording: Your driver is outside.
Your driver is re-attempting to deliver your order again.
Your order was successfully delivered.
Our delivery attempt was unsuccessful. Please click on 'Manage Delivery' to update any necessary information.
Your order was successfully returned to Jitsu for redelivery.
entries.note: The driver brought the parcel back to Jitsu's facility after a failed attempt, for another.

entries.wording: Your order cannot be returned to the store. Please contact support for further assistance.

Jitsu cannot deliver the parcel and sends the recipient to support.

entries.note: Jitsu gives up on the delivery, such as after failed attempts.
A request to leave a recycling bag out for collection, not about the parcel.

entries.wording: Your return was successfully picked up.
entries.note: A recycling bag or return capsule was collected, not the parcel.
A recycling bag or return capsule could not be collected, not the parcel.
A recycling bag or return capsule collection was flagged, not the parcel.
